editorial.blurb: LH Rooftop is a spectacular 22nd-floor dining destination where the Chicago River views and skyline steal the show, paired with solidly executed American fare.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early to beat the ID-check line in the lobby; you're paying for the view and atmosphere, so snag a table on the rooftop terrace during open season and order the Spicy Hibiscus Margarita—they don't skimp on the tequila.

topDishes.note: Perfectly seasoned and moist, a brunch standout
The cherry on top of a solid meal
